propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete commands are incorrectly counted as applied links instead of failures, causing batch_outcome to report success for work that never executed.

The root cause is missing --yes flag on link create/delete subcommands, causing ACLI to prompt for confirmation, read EOF from stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, and report command cancelled deterministically on every pass.

The except CalledProcessError arm in _update_one_dispatch_links increments links_applied regardless of failure type, with no diagnostic output, making the miscounting invisible to logs and bypass the silent-divergence canary.
Idempotent link removal races (concurrent deletion with 404/409 markers on either stderr or stdout) must remain counted as applied, distinguishing them from non-idempotent failures.
The narrowed idempotent check must inspect both stderr and stdout streams to avoid false positives when 404 markers appear on stdout, following the precedent in delete_issue at acli.py:739.
